solutions.latex:
The angle of depression equals the angle of elevation from the rabbit, so the angle at the rabbit is $42^\circ$. In the right-angled triangle with the $85$ m side opposite this angle and $d$ the hypotenuse:
$$\begin{aligned} \sin 42^\circ &= \dfrac{85}{d} \\ d &= \dfrac{85}{\sin 42^\circ} \\ &\approx 127.0 \text{ m} \end{aligned}$$

Let the foot of the eagle's vertical be $P$. Using the $85$ m height, find the horizontal distance from $P$ to the rabbit and to the burrow.

To the rabbit (angle $42^\circ$):
$$\begin{aligned} \tan 42^\circ &= \dfrac{85}{x_R} \\ x_R &= \dfrac{85}{\tan 42^\circ} \approx 94.40 \end{aligned}$$
To the burrow (angle $23^\circ$):
$$\begin{aligned} \tan 23^\circ &= \dfrac{85}{x_B} \\ x_B &= \dfrac{85}{\tan 23^\circ} \approx 200.25 \end{aligned}$$
Then
$$\begin{aligned} k &= x_B-x_R \\ &\approx 200.25-94.40 \\ &\approx 106 \text{ m} \end{aligned}$$

parts.latex:
Town $B$ is 125 km due west of town $C$.

Town $A$ is on a bearning $036^\circ$ from $B$ and on a bearning $320^\circ$ from $C$.

\exfigure{498_q11_1}

Not to scale

Find the distance from town $A$ to town $B$.

solutions.latex:
\exfigure{498_q11_s1}

Using the sine rule in the triangle with $BC = 125$, where $x = AB$:
$$\dfrac{x}{\sin 50^\circ} = \dfrac{125}{\sin 76^\circ}$$
$$\begin{aligned} x &= \dfrac{125 \times \sin 50^\circ}{\sin 76^\circ} \\ &\approx 98.69 \text{ km} \end{aligned}$$
criteria: Sets up the sine rule correctly, or equivalent merit
Finds a relevant angle in the triangle, or equivalent merit

7506.stem:
In the diagram below, the following measurements are given:

$\angle TAB = 30^\circ$.

$B$ is 50 m due east of A.

The bearing of $T$ from $B$ is $020^\circ$.

\exfigure{710_q13_1}

figures.cap: river with points A, B on one bank and T on the opposite bank

parts.latex: Show that $\angle ATB$ is $40^\circ$.
Calculate the distance $BT$, correct to the nearest metre.

solutions.latex:
The bearing of $T$ from $B$ is $020^\circ$, and $A$ is due west of $B$, so $\angle ABT$ is the right angle plus $20^\circ$:
$$\angle ABT = 90^\circ + 20^\circ = 110^\circ$$
Angle sum in $\triangle ABT$:
$$\begin{aligned} \angle ATB &= 180^\circ - 30^\circ - 110^\circ \\ &= 40^\circ \end{aligned}$$

meta.format_note: Rubric written by us (source had none). Source's \exfigure not present for this part; none added.

solutions.latex:
Using the sine rule in $\triangle ABT$:
$$\dfrac{BT}{\sin 30^\circ} = \dfrac{50}{\sin 40^\circ}$$
$$\begin{aligned} BT &= \dfrac{50}{\sin 40^\circ}\times\sin 30^\circ \\ &= 38.893\ldots \\ &= 39 \text{ m} \end{aligned}$$
criteria: Substitutes correctly into the sine rule and rearranges, or equivalent merit
Writes the sine rule with correct values, or equivalent merit
